added.member: UI: backdrop-filter reads what is really under the element, url(#id) included
added.summary: backdrop-filter's functions and url(#id) now run in order as one SVG filter graph over a capture of what is under the element where its composite draws: the screen, or the group it is drawn in (the backdrop root). og-render's UiLayer::backdrop captures it; the blur is an exact Gaussian rather than the glass pyramid, so a backdrop with no blur is sharp.

feConvolveMatrix and the lighting primitives read kernelUnitLength. feImage takes an element of the document by href="#id", drawn as <use> would draw it in the filtered element's user space (og-render's UiFilterOp::Layer).

fixed.member: UI: SVG filters run in the element's own space
fixed.summary: A blur, morphology, lighting, subregion, tile, image and turbulence of a turned, skewed or scaled element now run along the element's axes instead of the screen's.

breaking.change: UiFilter has a space (its map to CSS px, UiFilter::CSS the identity), and its primitives' subregions, lengths, positions and lights are in that space instead of CSS px. UiFilterOp::Lighting and UiFilterOp::Convolve take kernel_unit, and UiFilterOp::Layer is new.
breaking.fix: Build a UiFilter with ..Default::default() or space: UiFilter::CSS, and add kernel_unit: None to Lighting and Convolve.

breaking.change: UiLayer has backdrop: a layer that draws nothing and filters what is under its composite.
breaking.fix: Add backdrop: false to UiLayer literals.

breaking.change: BeginLayer takes a role (LayerRole: Draw, Backdrop, Image).
breaking.fix: Add role: LayerRole::Draw to BeginLayer literals.
